extension.title: Extension
extension.hero_desc: The extension sends detected videos to Abrek Download via local bridge. Captures are listed in real-time when the app is open.
extension.brave_step1: In Brave, type brave://extensions in the address bar. If using Chrome, chrome://extensions.
extension.brave_step2: Turn on Developer mode in the top right.
extension.brave_step4: Select the extension folder below. It installs immediately.
extension.brave_tip: Tip: Pin the extension icon to your toolbar. You can see captures from the popup and download in one click.
extension.firefox_step1: Type about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox in the address bar.
extension.firefox_step3: Select the manifest.json file in the folder below.
extension.firefox_note: Firefox removes temporary extensions on restart. You will need to reload it each session; permanent install requires extension signing.
extension.test_desc: Check whether the local bridge used by the extension is reachable.
extension.test_invalid_resp: Bridge responded but health status is invalid.
extension.disclaimer: Abrek Download should only be used for content you have the right to download. DRM-protected streams cannot be downloaded.
